programme.title: The Occupant
programme.desc: Angie was an undergraduate from Canada who was in holiday in Hong Kong as well as doing research work for her thesis - 'Chinese Superstition'. She looked for accommodation and met Hansom. While Angie disguised herself as a ghost to scare Hansom, he was thrown out of the window by a genuine ghost. Detective Valentino came to investigate the accident and they unfolded the actual happening of the tragic evening when Singer Lisa Law had shot her lover...

programme.title: Fun & Fury
programme.desc: Leon busts an international drug ring at Singapore in a startling fight sequence that will shock even the most jaded filmgoer. From there on it's laughs galore when Leon arrives on Hong Kong with his wife to be who is then kidnapped by her own father who objects to her marrying a police officer. Frankie Chan immediately comes to the aid of his long time friend and in a series of exciting sequences they pursue Leon's missing fiance. Together they encounter her father's bumbling gangster, the vivaciously devious Sharon Kwok, and a team of deadly western agents sent to destroy them. In an explosive finale laughter takes a backseat to tension as the two battle overwhelming odds and just when all appears lost Frankie comes to the rescue!

programme.title: MAN WANTED 3
programme.desc: Street boy Qian Jidong had been idolizing Pujun, one of the 'Double Eagles in Mong Kok' since childhood. His father was beaten because he owed Xiyang a loan, so Qian Jidong went to Xiyang desperately, but was captured by Xiyang. At a critical moment, Pujun appeared and saved his life. Then, Qian Jidong worked for Pujun. But Qian Jidong's girlfriend GIGI did not like him working in the underworld and finally broke up with him...

programme.title: E3 - The Guardian Angels Of French Heritage
programme.desc: From Burgundy to the Charente-Maritime, from Mont-Saint-Michel to the Chateau de Rambouillet, 'guardian angels' work to restore French national heritage. Who are these craftsmen and women, committed to renovating the country's finest monuments and how do they organise their projects, work that is sometimes on a titanic scale?

programme.title: E7 - Upper Ubaye
programme.desc: Formed by glaciers, the Ubaye Valley lies on the border between Dauphine and Provence and is surrounded by peaks rising over 3,000 metres. Today, it is part of the Mercantour National Park, which local residents are committed to promoting and protecting.

programme.title: E4 - Dear Old Bangers/Lewis, The Wind-Swept Island
programme.desc: A profile of Rene Chollet, a classic car restorer. A journey of discovery to the Isle of Lewis, in the north of Scotland, swept by the harsh winds from the open sea. A harsh natural environment that has shaped the lives of the few inhabitants for centuries.

programme.title: E29 - Along The Seine
programme.desc: The Seine is mainly known through Paris, which nevertheless represents only 13 km of its total length of 775 km. Meet the people who shape today's Seine and bear witness to its past. The journey begins in Conflans-Sainte-Honorine, in the Yvelines department, and continues to the English Channel, in Le Havre, Seine-Maritime.

programme.title: E19
programme.desc: A journey a world away from the usual tourist hotspots for an immersive visit to Overseas France. programme.title: E17 - Rosa Kanno (Paris)/Sarah Levy (Brussels)

Fueled by vengeance, justice, and his desire to protect the innocent, Apollo and his companions face relentless trials that test not only their strength but also their moral convictions.

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.title: E7
programme.desc: 講述在司法不公不義的社會中，地下秘密的士公司「彩虹運輸」存在著一位特殊部隊出身的代表的士司機替一群無法受到法律保護的被害者們找回公理。

programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.title: Managing Middle East
programme.desc: Managing Middle East is CNBC's new flagship interview series that takes you inside the minds of the business leaders shaping one of the world's most dynamic regions. Fronted by CNBC's Dan Murphy, the series uncovers how the region's most influential leaders are navigating transformation, global expansion, capital markets, technology, energy transition, geopolitics and long-term growth.

programme.title: Executive Decisions
programme.desc: ‘Executive Decisions' is a CNBC podcast offering a rare window into the minds of top decision-makers. Through candid conversations about risk, doubt and conviction, the series reminds us that even the most powerful face uncertainty and trade-offs.

programme.title: Executive Decisions

Through candid conversations about risk, doubt and conviction, the series reminds us that even the most powerful face uncertainty and trade-offs.

programme.title: Managing Middle East
programme.desc: Managing Middle East is CNBC's new flagship interview series that takes you inside the minds of the business leaders shaping one of the world's most dynamic regions. Fronted by CNBC's Dan Murphy, the series uncovers how the region's most influential leaders are navigating transformation, global expansion, capital markets, technology, energy transition, geopolitics and long-term growth.

programme.desc: 2035年，與人類形象無異的仿生人由於發展過快，引發公眾的擔憂。“明眸”組織專門負責仿生人案件，組員程諾頭腦冷靜，安秋善於共情，面對仿生人不斷被害，兩人聯手揭開謎團。眾生煙火，仿生人間。人類和仿生人的命運都正在被悄悄改寫......

programme.title: E2
